subject: Re: Acme Corp - Redwood POC plan & success criteria
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sara Li <sara.li@finlytics.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-15T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: Acme POC: success criteria & next steps

Hi Sara,

Thanks again for the discovery call today — great context. Per our conversation, I pulled together a short POC plan and success criteria so we have alignment before we kick off. Please review and confirm or flag anything I missed.

High-level success criteria (proposed):
- Demo-grade latency: 95th percentile tail < 300ms for typical 256-token prompts
- Throughput: sustained 50 qps in the target demo environment (burst to 75 qps)
- Cost target: modeled token cost <= $0.02 per 1k tokens for evaluation workload
- Quality: top-line evaluation F1 / human review score >= current baseline (we'll provide test prompts)
- Data controls: logs retained for 30 days; PII redaction validated

Evaluation plan / timeline (proposed):
- Week 0 (this week): finalize mutual action plan & access (you provide test prompts and a sample dataset listing)
- Week 1: environment setup + connectivity checks; run initial baseline tests
- Week 2: run evaluation suite, iterate on prompt/config; capture metrics
- Week 3: demo + decision meeting

Ownership / asks:
- Acme: provide sample dataset description, list of test prompts, point person for infra + procurement (we'll need firewall/VPN details if applicable)
- Redwood: Vivek will run setup and be primary SE; I will coordinate logistics and timelines

Next steps (action items):
1) Sara: confirm success criteria and provide sample dataset listing by EOD Thu (2026-06-17)
2) Acme infra: share any network allowlists or onboarding steps
3) Redwood: schedule kickoff — Vivek suggested Tues/Wed next week; I can send calendar invites after we confirm

Attachments: redwood-poc-success-criteria.pdf, mutual-action-plan.xlsx

If that looks good, we'll treat that as the mutual action plan and start the access steps once you confirm.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

----
Redwood Inference | Make inference predictable and economical
From: Sara Li <sara.li@finlytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: John Miller <john.miller@finlytics.com>
Date: 2026-06-16T09:12:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Acme POC: success criteria & next steps

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the clear recap — really helpful. A couple quick clarifications from our side:

- Data retention: our security team requires retention to be configurable; 30 days is okay as a starting point but we need the option to reduce to 7 days for certain datasets. Is that supported?
- Dataset size: the sample we can share is ~150GB of text (logs + product metadata). For the POC we'll initially use a 10GB subset. Will that be fine for your baseline tests?

Also looping in John (infra) for network details — John, can you confirm if we need to open any ports or provide a bastion host?

We can aim for a kickoff on Tue 06/23 if that still works for Vivek.

Thanks,
Sara Li
Director, Product | Finlytics (Acme division)
sara.li@finlytics.com
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Sara Li <sara.li@finlytics.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-16T11:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Acme POC: success criteria & next steps

Sara/Marissa,

Thanks — quick technical notes from the SE side:
- Retention: our platform supports configurable retention policies per dataset; we can set to 7/30/90 days per dataset. For PII-sensitive datasets we recommend 7 days during evaluation.
- Dataset size: 10GB is more than enough for the initial evaluation and will keep run times fast. For throughput profiling we can stage a synthetic workload to simulate the 150GB corpus distribution if you want to stress-test.
- Network: if you prefer a private connection, we support IP allowlists and a VPN/bastion approach. John, if you can share your firewall rules we can advise exact egress IPs.

Proposed kickoff slots: Tue 2026-06-23 10:00-11:00 PT or Wed 2026-06-24 09:00-10:00 PT. I can do either.

I've attached a short access checklist (se-access-steps.md) with the minimal information we'll need to get started.

--
Vivek Kulkarni
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sara Li <sara.li@finlytics.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, John Miller <john.miller@finlytics.com>
Date: 2026-06-16T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Acme POC: success criteria & next steps

Great — thanks everyone.

Sara: noted on retention; we'll set up dataset-level retention and default to 7 days for PII. Please send the 10GB sample subset and a short list of 20-30 test prompts by EOD Friday 2026-06-18 so we can hit the timeline.
John: can you share firewall/egress details or a contact who owns procurement connectivity? If you prefer, we can do a short network runbook call and Vivek can walk through the allowlist steps.

Kickoff: locking Tue 06/23 10:00 PT for now — I'll send a calendar invite to the group.

Action summary:
- Acme (Sara): sample subset + test prompts (due 2026-06-18)
- Acme (John): network allowlist or contact
- Redwood (Vivek): prepare environment + synthetic load for throughput testing
- Redwood (Marissa): calendar invite + mutual-action-plan update

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Marissa

Hi Sara / John — quick weekly nudge as we approach kickoff next week. Small checklist and status: 

- Sample dataset: pending (Sara) — we still need the 10GB sample subset and the 20-30 test prompts. If you need more time, please let me know; we can shift the evaluation schedule by one week but prefer to keep Tue 06/23 if possible.
- Network allowlist: pending (John) — Vivek has provided the egress IPs and checklist; please confirm whether your firewall team needs a short runbook call.
- Procurement / paperwork: procurement@acme.com, any redlines? Rishi, FYI — we may need a quick procurement touchpoint after the POC for reserved capacity pricing if the evaluation hits targets.

If helpful, I can hop on a 15-min sync today to unblock anything urgent. Otherwise, please reply with the items above by EOD today so Vivek can proceed with environment prep.
